response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep exposure to TypeScript, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and agentic workflows via MCP, with notable open-source contributions and technical leadership — but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years in production-grade AI systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or direct enterprise GenAI deployment, which are core to the role.
strengths: Extensive experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS CDK)
Proven work on AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Strong technical leadership through open-source projects and mentoring initiatives
concerns: No clear documentation of 8+ years specifically in production AI/GenAI systems
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architecture implementation
Limited evidence of enterprise customer-facing technical leadership in GenAI contexts
